name: 60V 10A Lithium Battery Charger – 69.35V DC Output | High Power Charger
description:
High-performance 60V 10A Lithium Battery Charger designed for compatible 60V lithium battery packs. The charger delivers a regulated 69.35V DC / 10A output for reliable and efficient battery charging.Charge your 60V lithium battery safely and efficiently with this 10A high-performance battery charger. Designed for compatible 60V lithium battery packs, this charger provides a regulated 69.35V DC output at 10A, helping deliver reliable and consistent charging performance.

The charger supports a wide AC input range of 160V–280V at 50/60Hz, making it suitable for use in areas where mains voltage may vary. Its sturdy metal enclosure with integrated cooling fins is designed for effective heat dissipation and dependable everyday operation.

It comes with a power cable and charging connector, making it a convenient charging solution for compatible electric vehicles and lithium battery systems.

Important: Please verify that your battery is a 60V lithium battery requiring a 69.35V charging voltage and that the connector polarity matches before connecting the charger.
